evidence: bare_number_card: In seg3:mid and seg3:end two teal circles each show the bare number '127%'. Nothing is demonstrated, and the S&P 500's 195% never appears.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start, mid and end show two identical teal circles, both reading '127%' and both labelled 'Billionaire wealth'. Meanwhile the narration says 'the S&P 500 alone grew 195 percent'. The comparison that carries the payoff is never shown, and the same broken picture is held through seg4 to the end.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine took the same series for both sides. The S&P 500 value (195%) and its label never reached the second circle.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw billionaire wealth at +127% against the S&P 500 at +195% as two quantities growing side by side. For example, two piles or vessels that Data fills, with the S&P one clearly overtaking. Label them 'Billionaire wealth +127%' and 'S&P 500 +195%' in ink with high contrast. Hold the right picture into the closing so the punchline 'most of this is just stocks' is visible.
